form.title: Tell a story
form.intro: Write a memory and link it to the people it is about. The whole family will be able to read it.
form.contentOptional: Optional when the memory has a photo.

photos.label: Photos
photos.limit_one: A memory can have only one photo.
photos.limit_other: A memory can have up to {{count}} photos.
photos.caption: Caption of photo {{position}}

errors.unsupported: This file is not a photo Mbia can use. Remove it and choose a JPEG, PNG or WEBP photo.
errors.tooLarge: This photo is too large. Remove it and choose a photo of 15 MB or less.
errors.failed: The photo could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid: This file cannot be used as a photo. Remove it and choose another one.

form.tooLong: This text cannot be longer than {{max, number}} characters.
form.personsHint: Choose at least one person to publish.
form.allChosen: The people found are already chosen.
form.readOnly: Your role in this family does not allow adding a memory.

errors.PERSON_NOT_ACTIVE: One of the chosen people was archived or merged in the meantime. Remove them, then publish again.
errors.PERSON_NOT_FOUND: One of the chosen people is no longer part of the family. Remove them, then publish again.
errors.MEMORY_PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED_one: A memory can have only one photo. Remove the extra photos, then publish again.
errors.MEMORY_PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED_other: A memory can have up to {{count}} photos. Remove the extra photos, then publish again.
errors.MEDIA_NOT_READY: One of the photos is not ready yet. Remove it and add it again, then publish.
errors.MEDIA_ALREADY_USED: One of the photos is already used elsewhere. Remove it and add it again, then publish.
errors.MEDIA_NOT_FOUND: One of the photos can no longer be found. Remove it and add it again, then publish.

notFound.body: This memory does not exist or is no longer visible in this family.

saved: Your changes to “{{title}}” have been saved.
